verified_facts.text: Baur au Lac has been in Zurich since 1844.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your home in Zurich since 1844

verified_facts.text: Baur au Lac is a family-run hotel now in its seventh generation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since its opening in 1844, the hotel has been run by the same family – now in its seventh generation.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in its own private park right on the shores of Lake Zurich, in central Zurich.
verified_facts.excerpt: Baur au Lac is centrally located in the heart of Zurich, nestled in a private park right on the shores of Lake Zurich.

verified_facts.text: The Bahnhofstrasse, Buerkliplatz and the historic Old Town, with the Tonhalle and the Opera House, are a short walk away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a short walk away are the famous Bahnhofstrasse, Bürkliplatz, and the historic Old Town, home to cultural institutions such as the Tonhalle and the Opera House.

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite is individually designed, with views of the private park, the city or, depending on category, Lake Zurich and the Alps.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room and suite is individually designed and offers views of the private park, the city or – depending on the category – Lake Zurich and the Alps.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World and Swiss Deluxe Hotels.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World and Swiss Deluxe Hotels

verified_facts.text: Marguita sits right on Lake Zurich and serves Mediterranean cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated right on Lake Zurich, Marguita celebrates the vibrancy of Mediterranean cuisine.

verified_facts.text: Le Hall, the historic lobby bar, is called the living room of Zurich.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our historic lobby bar "Le Hall" is the heart of the Baur au Lac and also the "living room of Zurich".

verified_facts.text: Le Hall serves desserts from the hotel's own patisserie.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in timeless favourites and exquisite desserts from our own patisserie.

verified_facts.text: Baur au Lac Vins is a separate wine shop with fine wines, premium spirits and delicacies.
verified_facts.excerpt: You will find fine wines, premium spirits and delicacies in the separate wine shop, Baur au Lac Vins.

verified_facts.text: The fitness area has a view of Lake Zurich and the Alps.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our fitness area is equipped with the most innovative technologies and a spectacular view of Lake Zurich and the Alps.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange private trips on Lake Zurich aboard the historic saloon boat Tugenia.
verified_facts.excerpt: such as private trips on Lake Zurich aboard the nostalgic “Tugenia

verified_facts.text: Services include a 24-hour concierge, limousine and transfer service from the airport or main station, valet and garage services, and twice-daily housekeeping.
verified_facts.excerpt: This includes, amongst other things, a 24-hour concierge, a limousine and transfer service from the airport or main railway station, valet and garage services, as well as a twice-daily housekeeping service.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites with connecting doors suit multi-generational stays.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is ideal for multi-generational stays. Rooms and suites with connecting doors offer space for spending time together whilst also providing privacy.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has its own soft toys, Leo and Eli, for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s own soft toys, Leo and Eli, add to the fun, charmingly keeping both young and old company.

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcome at CHF 45 per dog per day, with custom-designed beds, bowls and a special dog menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, dogs are very welcome at Baur au Lac, at a cost of CHF 45 per dog per day. With custom-designed beds, Baur au Lac bowls, and a special dog menu, your four-legged companion enjoys the same comfort as you.

verified_facts.text: Dogs are not permitted in the restaurants, except on the Marguita terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that dogs are not permitted in our restaurants, with the exception of the Marguita terrace.

verified_facts.text: A book about the hotel was created in collaboration with Assouline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Created in collaboration with Assouline, the book brings together moments past and present.

verified_facts.text: Rooms mix Art Deco, Louis XVI and Regency styles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside, rooms tastefully mix Art Deco, Louis XVI, and Regency styles

verified_facts.text: The hotel has hosted guests such as Joan Miro and Placido Domingo.
verified_facts.excerpt: this property has hosted the likes of Joan Miró and Plácido Domingo

verified_facts.text: Some rooms have a balcony on the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: if you're lucky, you'll get a room with a balcony on the water
